_doc: Polygons (pixel x, y at 1920x1080) of image regions that are clearly outside the glovebox, seen through its windows, for each fixed Amcrest camera. privacy_blur.py blurs them. Drawn by hand on the 2026-11-19 stills; redraw if a camera is re-aimed. Equipment inside the box that is seen against the windows is left out of the polygons where practical.
